name: massive clay pots
descriptions: The pot facing to the south is positioned to aim the figure’s fearful face directly at the dragon carving on the wall opposite.
The pots facing to the northwest and southeast are not aligned with any carvings.
It appears a dusty, but still useable mechanism is set beneath the pots to enable you to turn them.
turnDescription: You carefully turn the massive clay pots, and they rotate with surprising ease. The ancient mechanism beneath them grinds to life...

turnEffect.message: A hidden door opens, revealing a secret passage to the north!
